notes.title: Nigate Tale is now officially released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/9b17a547fa135bb8ad491951f7685c70b8c1f072.png[/img]

Hello there, unexpected heroes!

It's been a long time since the launch of Early Access, during which the development team was almost at a standstill for a long period due to various reasons. Eventually, it was confirmed that they were unable to complete the game's subsequent development.

We at 2P Games, as the publisher of Nigate Tale, took over the game’s development with the intention of fulfilling our players' expectations. However, to our surprise, the game had serious fundamental problems. To address these challenges and finish the development, we spent half a year reconstructing the entire game content and optimizing numerous problems in the process.

The later stages of development of the game focused on designing the new Monster Girls, during which we created their corresponding blessings and pet mechanisms to complete the last missing piece of the game. Additionally, we are preparing a text revision to further enhance the quality of the game after its full release.

[b]Today, we’re excited to share the 1.0 release with you all![/b]
We want to sincerely thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your long-term support and understanding. Every adjustment and optimization was made possible thanks to your feedback and suggestions. Your help played a crucial role in the successful completion of the game's development. We hope you enjoy the game, with its new approach, new world, and new Monster Girls!

[h2]About old game saves[/h2]

Due to an update on the data structure, the old save data is no longer compatible with this version.

However, if you want to keep your old save data, you can find it here:
Path: [u]C:\Users\”User Name”\AppData\Local\Roguelite\Saved\SaveGames[/u]

Please note that all your files, no matter compatible or not, are under the folder above. Please always backup before doing anything to your game save.

If you encounter any problems during the game, or have any comments and suggestions about the game, you can join our Discord server and contact us. We’ll take your feedback and suggestions into consideration to create a more enjoyable gaming experience.

2P Games Team

notes.title: Progress in the development of the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
 
Publisher 2P Games here.  
First, thank you for your support and love for Nigate Tale. With this announcement, we want to share what has been happening these past months and the current state of game development. 
 
Unfortunately, during the two-year pandemic, the original development team Hermit Games of Nigate Tale encountered many difficulties. The development of the follow-up version content of the game has been stagnant for a long time. Finally, the developer has determined that they cannot maintain the follow-up development of the game. 
 
To avoid disappointing the expectations of players and enabling Nigate Tale to have a complete gaming experience, a few months ago we -the 2P Games team- took over the developing build of Nigate Tale and hoped to complete the remaining work and make it through to the full release. 
 
Unexpectedly, after a comprehensive review of the Nigate Tale build, we found that the problems were far more complex than we imagined. There are severe problems in the fundamentals of the game and it needs an entire restructuring before the follow-up work can begin. It will only optimize the overall gaming experience and won’t add more gameplay content, which can feel very unrewarding especially to you all. However, to avoid disappointing the players who bought Nigate Tale, we finally decided to restructure the game for a better experience for everyone who bought and plays the game.  
 
After a few months of work, the restructuring of Nigate Tale is nearing completion. At the same time, we have also fully adjusted and optimized some values and unreasonable designs. The current version has entered the testing stage and will be updated soon if successful. But for players looking forward to the new version of Nigate Tale, we must apologize first. The current optimization content alone cannot meet everyone's expectations. We can only promise to continue improving the experience and updating the game content in the future. 
 
[One of the new monster girls planned to be added to the game] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/64ba69f628e91c6274e5258bc2bf1907e9dc81cd.jpg[/img] 
 
Although offering a game discount currently is inappropriate, it is also to recover some of the costs for subsequent research and development. Therefore, during this year's Steam Summer Sale, we are having a 50% OFF. The highest discount ever. If you still look forward to Nigate Tale, you might as well pay attention to us. We will do our best to bring you a complete Nigate Tale. 
Finally, thank you again for your long-term support and love for Nigate Tale. We hope to bring you a better gaming experience through our efforts. 
 
2P Games team

notes.title: Version 0.4 is ready for download!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/7c64d106c28745c2824d5f4f223ceb2e812c6d3e.jpg[/img]

Well guys, we made it in time! A few days before the Chinese New Year, and despite all the setbacks we’ve faced, we have managed to release this expected new update of Nigate Tale. Version 0.4 opens the door to a new stage in the history of the game, with many more surprises to come. The whole team expects to be able to tell you more after the national holidays, but for now? Let's enjoy what we have in our hands!

We don't want to unnecessarily extend ourselves by detailing again the content of the major patch (read the patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1048350/eventcomments/4792394847116798642]here[/url]), but to thank all of our players one more time for their patience and support since Nigate Tale was launched on Early Access in April 2021.

Both Hermit Games and 2P Games are very happy to count on such a kind and involved community. Also, we would like to send a big "thank you”' to those content creators who enjoyed Nigate Tale in their live streams and videos, for helping us bring the magic of the game to a weirder audience across the globe. You are all essential to our project, and none of us will forget that you have been there when we needed you the most.

We hope to continue counting on all of you from now on, and that this new game patch will make you even more eager to play what's to come. Now, take your swords and head to the castle to smash some goblins! Remember that if you have any doubts or problems or even any feedback that you want to tell us about, we read them both in the comments section and in the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU]2P Games Discord channel[/url].

[h2]NOTES[/h2]

[b]If you were playing v.0.3 before the v.0.4 update[/b]
There’s nothing to worry about, just keep playing as usual! All the objects you collected until then will return to your hand, including the points spent to unlock new skills or the cakes you gave to the monster girls. The best thing about it is that you can try different character builds without starting a new adventure and discover which one fits your play style better.

[b]If you played the beta version before the update[/b]
The game will be resumed at the same point you left it without needing to redistribute the skill points and the presents for monster girls.

[b]Don’t get back to v.0.3 after playing v.0.4 beta version[/b]
Please wait until January 27th before making any changes on your current version of Nigate Tale — otherwise your data will be corrupted.

There’s a small probability that your game file gets corrupted after the new major update, so we strongly recommend you copy them from C:\ Users\（Username）\AppData\Local\Roguelite\Saved to a separate folder.
The save data will be on C:\Users \(your Windows username) \AppData \Local \Roguelite \Saved \SaveGames and copy that folder to somewhere safe! 

Thanks for reading, happy gaming!

notes.title: Major update coming on January 27th!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear heroes!

This is the news we’ve been expecting to announce for the last four months, and it’s finally here after all! The latest [b]major update[/b] for Nigate Tale, which we tested in late December with our current player base, will be [b]available for every Steam user that purchases the game from January 27th onwards[/b]. It’s coming with a bunch of changes you'll identify at first sight, and other not-so-visible upgrades focused on making the game experience smoother and more balanced than before.

In our latest announcement, we already detailed most of the changes that players will find in Nigate Tale after its corresponding patch. Today, you’ll find further information since our team identified several new bugs in the past weeks thanks to your invaluable help via Discord. Let’s begin!

[b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] The visible interface has been completely reworked to look vivid and more cartoonish. We hope you’re a big fan of blue and yellow tones!
[/list]
[b]The sewers[/b]
[list]
[*] The sewers of the castle have been refurbished, taking the form of a larger and cozier circular courtyard. The monster girls will be walking between their own semi-open rooms, built on small elevations around the central corridor, and this new hallway. Their personal spaces will receive new customizations as your relationship with them strengthens.
[*] You can access the wiki from the pause menu, so Mickey the merchant will now trade pieces of cake for cute gifts to get a higher level of friendship with the monster girls.
[*] The weapon upgrade service is now available at Alona’s store.
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] Most of the levels have been redesigned as well to include new special quests and challenges.
[*] You’ll find a wider variety of traps, and a large number of them too.
[*] Players will meet the castle’s owner to challenge him at the end of his level.
[/list]
[b]Monster girls[/b]
[list]
[*] A new monster girl will join your tour team after defeating the lord of the castle. Who might she be?
[*] The friendship system has been reworked. We’re introducing new slots to equip blessing enhancements at the beginning of each run. There are dozens of different choices and combinations!
[*] Unlock new slots by giving the monster girls any of the special gifts sold by Mickey at his stall.
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Some enemies’ designs received an important upgrade, and they’re now stronger in Hard Mode.
[/list]
If you feel there's something missing, or you want to share your thoughts on it, please use the comment box below. Have a nice week, and happy gaming!
2P Games

notes.title: Join the new beta test starting today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/9d261c60c05c70be7f22fd3816a1cae230a4738f.png[/img]

Hello there, unexpected heroes!

The next update for Nigate Tale is almost out of the oven, with only a few fixes and some parts of the English localization missing yet. We are very excited to share with you all these new features, and as we foresee that it may take a few weeks longer than expected, today we bring you a little surprise. If you have been following our updates on Twitter you will already know what it is: you can join today the beta testing of our next content update!

[h2]How to jump into the beta testing branch:[/h2]

Our beta branch is open to everyone, so you should be able to find the new branch AdvanceTest on the Branch options. To join the beta, please follow these steps:

[b]1. Right-Click Nigate Tale on your Library, and choose Properties[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fc27a9936ab5fa679fec46b86729381e371f5afe.png[/img]

[b]2. In the Properties menu, click on the Betas tab[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/803f17ab50b7e7b511ff6604b895e39e96621e60.png[/img]

[b]3. Choose advancetest - Advance Test from the beta option and you're set![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/2469cf286d331cba0eb8d52d2b05e399c53af7e2.png[/img]

You should now see our Nigate Tale is updating the beat version. After the update process is completed, you could start playing the latest version.

[u]Please notice that, as we are still working on the localization and the build itself, you'll find untranslated sentences and maybe some bugs in this Beta version. That is to be expected, given that it is a beta after all -- but please let us know your feedback on our Discord server, our developers will fix them in our future updates.[/u]

[h2]This is what you will find from now on in the beta branch of Nigate Tale:[/h2]

[b]The Sewers[/b]
Someone magically refurbished the sewers of the castle and now they’ve become a circular courtyard with several mini-rooms around it. The area is larger than before but feels much cozier.

The monster girls will settle in these elevated, semi-open rooms. They will also help you customize your base as your relationship strengthens.

Since you can access the wiki from the pause menu, Mickey the merchant will now trade pieces of cake for cute gifts to get a higher level of friendship with the monster girls.

The weapon upgrade service is now available at Alona’s store. Don’t miss it!


[b]Interface[/b]
The visible interface has been completely reworked to look vivid and more cartoonish. Let us know if you like its new color palette <3


[b]Levels[/b]
Most of the levels have been redesigned as well and there’s a wide variety of new adventures waiting for you. Find quests, special challenges, and more!

Players will meet the castle’s owner to challenge him at the end of his level.

You’ll find a wider variety of traps, and a large number of them too.


[h2]Enemies[/h2]
Some enemies’ designs received an important upgrade. Can you recognize them now?

Enemies are now stronger in Hard Mode.


[h2]Monster Girls[/h2]
A new monster girl will join your tour team after defeating the lord of the castle. Who might this new ally be?
The friendship system has been reworked. We’re introducing new slots to equip blessing enhancements at the beginning of each run. There are dozens of different choices and combinations!
Unlock new slots by giving the monster girls any of the special gifts sold by Mickey at his stall.

Please bear in mind that some features of the game might be a bit unstable in this beta version, so your reports will be greatly appreciated. We hope you enjoy all these new features and continue to support Hermit Games in its aim to make Nigate Tale the best roguelike of 2022.
Thank you very much!

notes.title: NIGATE TALE WILL RECEIVE A MAJOR UPDATE IN DECEMBER

We’ve been working hard to solve the outstanding issues and develop new content, but as it happens often in games development, overcoming a challenge brings new ones, and we think the game needs more time to reach its full potential as our community of gamers deserves. notes.title: Nigate Tale V0.3.02_2401 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’ve been hard at work developing the next major update of Nigate Tale, and after a long journey, we’re glad to announce that we’re releasing Nigate Tale V.0.3 – featuring our New Monster Girl, Kris, the Electric Ray Girl, the little princess of the Skatians! We’re sure her name rings a bell –keep reading to discover why! On top of that, we have made a few adjustment to Rothschild and her blessing, as well as added 3 brand new Tarot Cards. Here’s full list for our V0.3 update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/e6927a2869009007e047c58e8a56adad82130325.png[/img]

[h2]Kris, The Electric Ray Girl, The Little Princess of the Skatians[/h2]

Kris is a little princess of the Skatians, and every creature that lives underwater loves her. She was caught and brought to this place along with her people, only to be treated as seafood. She survived thanks to her people, who protected her, and the mutation that changed everything. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fcfcd99956ed1686fb27cfdc5460be8a2e10f398.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Blessing: Kris have the power of electricity. Kris’ blessings will charge your weapons with electricity, which makes them deal more damage; and every attack can generate lightning orbs. These Orbs bounce between enemies – a great way to wreak havoc upon your adversaries!  
[*] Pet: Kris’ pet form can shoot an orb of lightning that bounces between monsters, dealing damage in her wake. She can also shoot lightning beams!
[*] Ultimate: Kris’ Ultimate Form is the Eye of the Storm! She can generate up to 3 orbs of lightning that will orbit around you, dealing damage to any enemy that get too close to you. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/ed457cbd832cf4a91057a6cfaff2adb1b8f8823c.gif[/img]

As we mentioned, her name and design probably sounds familiar to you, right? That’s because she was the protagonist of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048350/view/3034837093421415311]first dev blog![/url]  

[h2]New Tarot Card[/h2]

With the V0.3 update, we’re introducing 3 extraordinary Tarot Cards into our game that can change the tide of battle for you: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fe5a349ce4bf5c8b9ffd5452fa0bda3c326a6ebd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Upside Down - Sacrifice: You cannot obtain Blessings, but attribute buffs have a 100% bonus (bonus damage, Shield, HP, or Gold).
[*] Tank - Victory: Your Weapons deal 200% more damage, but you also take 100% more damage.
[*] Wheel of Fate - Reincarnation: Increase the level of your Melee/Ranged Blessings by 3, but you can’t use your Support Weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/a78f0c2b03bfc94ca9fbe45947b2f0c2c17176fa.gif[/img]

NOTE: Tanks are actually players or characters who can take a lot of damage. It would make more sense to call it “Cristal Cannon” – something fragile that can deal insane amounts of damage. 

[h2]Update for Rothschild[/h2]

In the past months we’ve realized there were some design flaws in Rothschild. To begin with, as the Kitty Coins are introduced at the very beginning of the game, they can make it pretty much useless. Same goes for the devices – a blessing affecting only one device made them less useful, so we’ve adjusted how that works too. 

Here are the list of changes for Rotshchild in V0.3: 

[list]
[*] Getting more Kitty Coins won’t increase your damage output
[*] You can now increase your damage for all devices with a single blessing
[*] We’ve adjusted the frequency with which you can summon devices – Rothschild is the one who keeps summoning Aircraft and cannons, after all! 
[*] We’ve moved summoning aircraft by rolling to another skill
[*] We’re temporarily removing Summon Storm to improve how it looks – right now it can make the battlefield a mess. 
[/list]


That’s all for today! We hope you like this update – please let us know your thoughts here in the Steam forums, on our Discord server or through our social media channels, we need your feedback to keep improving Nigate Tale! Have a great week!

notes.title: Nigate Tale V0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]1.	Brand New Vigor System[/h2]

Over the past weeks, we have been collecting lots of useful feedback about ranged and melee weapons. In its current version, ranged weapons are overpowered, which makes melee weapons look weak in comparison. To solve this balance problem (especially sensible when you fight elite monsters and bosses), we designed and implemented the Vigor System. Basically, you have to hit them to drop their Vigor, and when it reaches 0 they gain the Broken status. That, in turn, makes them temporarily vulnerable to melee weapons. 

1.	Monsters with Vigor are invulnerable until you empty their Vigor bar, just like if it was a shield 100% effective against all kinds of attacks.
2.	You can reduce monsters' Vigor by using weapons (both ranged and melee) and traps, but melee weapons are the most effective.
3.	When Vigor drops to zero, a monster becomes Broken. A Broken monster cannot move, so it always takes critical damage.
4.	When a monster recovers from its Broken status, it becomes more aggressive for a limited time during which its Vigor cannot be reduced.

[h2]2.	Mutant Monsters are coming![/h2]

In Nigate Tale V0.2, we will also introduce a new category of special enemies: the Mutant Monsters! You will meet these creatures randomly here and there. These are all the kinds of Mutant Monsters you can find: 

1.	Healer: heals nearby enemies by using the Healing Chain Skill (cannot heal themselves).
2.	Volt: creates an Electrified Area that causes damage to the player. 
3.	Binder: creates stun trap areas. 
4.	Glutton: randomly drops bombs or cheese portions, so it can be dangerous but also help you recover some HP!
5.	Cursed: becomes an unbeatable ghost after being defeated. It will attack you until you leave the room.
6.	Ascetic: when this one dies, it will heal all the other monsters in the room to their max HP.
7.	Matrix: summons three conveyors around you, which will teleport you away to different positions on the map.
8.	Echo: summons multiple shadows, but these disappear when you kill the monster.
9.	Runner: runs very, very fast -- no point in trying to run away from it!

[h2]3.	Balance and QoL adjustments [/h2]

[h3]Battle:[/h3]
1.	All weapons: basic damage increased. All weapons have the same 10% Basic Critical Strike Chance now, which triples the basic damage.
2.	Wrench: Fixed a bug that makes Magic Core Whirlwind Combo three times higher damage frequency.
3.	Shotgun: we adjusted the Magic Core Compound Reload from 8 to 4 additional bullets.
4.	Shotgun: we adjust the Magic Core Rapid Reload from 10 to 6 bullets.
5.	Stun: Now, players won't be stunned so often − but some skills still can stun you, so be careful!
6.	Roll: the invulnerability window is longer now (the time which enemies cannot hurt you while you roll)
7.	Weapon: We adjusted the Attacking Anime for Hammer and Sword.

[h3]Blessings:[/h3]

1.	Circe: We dropped the rolling damage for the Shadow.
2.	Mayonna: We adjusted the Freeze damage for Mayonna. Now you can do more damage with her blessing.

[h3]Monsters:[/h3]

1.	Goblin Shield Soldier: HP increased.
2.	Goblin Weeder: Their moving speed is slower now, but they can knock you further than before.
3.	Goblin Butcher: Their Ghost lasts a shorter time now.
4.	Magic Frog: We adjusted their magic, so you can now have more time to dodge.
5.	Cerberus/Demon Dog: After a few changes in their AI, these good bois are smarter now.
6.	Lost Warrior: They're now stronger and faster.
7.	Scarecrow: When a Scarecrow dies, the ghost on the map should disappear.
8.	Deathly Saluter: We made some changes on their Aggro, and we changed the Effect for a better look.
9.	We also adjusted the skill for Lance, Bill, Oggs the Lobster Guard, Albert Beelzebub, Kura the Lifestealer and Baphomet. Please check it out in the game!

[h3]Talents (comparing Before vs After recent changes)[/h3]

1.	Charge: until now, this talent gave you a 10% chance to complete the Recharge immediately (the Cooldown Time is 3 minutes) after using a Monster fatality there was a. Now, after you use your Monster Ultimate attack, you will enter the Critical status and inflict only Critical Strikes for a short period of time (3, 4 or 6 seconds).
2.	Rapid: up until now, this talent reduced the Cooldown Time of your Pet's Ultimate by 10%. Now, defeating enemies charges your Monster Ultimate for an additional amount (in a 2%, 4%, 6%).
3.	Sense: after using a Monster Fatality, there was a 30% chance that the Pet immediately uses its Ultimate attack freely. Now, receiving damage charges your Monster Ultimate (from 1% to 3%).
4.	Modified Defensive Algorithm: every time you receive damage, there was a 2% chance of being immune to this damage. Now when you are attacked by nearby threats, you have a chance (3%, 6% or 9 %) to Dodge the attack.
5.	Modified Assault Algorithm: before, defeating the enemy would sometimes (10%) heal 1 point of HP. Now it increases your damage output (5/10/15 %) when there are no enemies around you.
6.	Legacy of the Forerunner: before, at the end of the game you got 10 additional Monster Crystals for every level you had cleared. Now you get more Gold (10/20/30 %) out of a Gold Bag.
7.	Free Cake becomes Cake of Charisma: when obtaining Monster Crystals, there was a 10% chance of receiving an additional Meteorite Fragment. Now whenever you get a Magic Cake you increase your Max HP (5/10/15).
8.	Free Crystal becomes Meteor of Value: When obtaining Monster Crystals, there was a 10% chance of getting an additional Meteorite Fragment. Now It grants you some Gold (20/40/60) whenever you get a Meteorite Fragment.
9.	After this update, your Talents will be reset -- but we will keep the Monster Crystal you spend and give them back to you.

[h3]Tarot Cards:[/h3]
1.	Moon: before, there was a 30% chance that 0 Energy was consumed when you unleash an Ultimate attack, and the Cooldown Time was 120 seconds. Now, Ultimate attacks are free, but their cooldown time is 300 seconds.
2.	Trail: before, it increased the HP regeneration of any Respawn effect by 100% but reduced max HP by 30%. Now the HP Regeneration of any Respawn effect is increased to 100%, but Max HP is reduced by 20%.

[h3]Pets:[/h3]
Circe: now Summons only 1 Shadow. 

[h3]For Fatality:[/h3]
1.	Circe: Void Plane lasts shorter.
2.	Mayonna: Entangling Touch lasts shorter.

[h3]Levels:[/h3]
1.	We adjusted the maps and made some of them more spacious to make battles more enjoyable.
2.	We adjust the Monster choice for some maps to make you have a better battle experience.
3.	New maps are coming! We will tell you more about this very soon.

notes.title: Having a good time with Hermit Games
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our unexpected heroes!

Today we bring a special update related to the event on Discord last Thursday. As many of you already know, [b]Hermit Games and 2P Games[/b] celebrated their [b]first community Q&A[/b]. Totoro, the producer of [i]Nigate Tale[/i], represented the games studio, and Steven Zeng came in behalf of 2P Games to assist Totoro. Together, they replied to several questions of the players about the future of [i]Nigate Tale[/i].

The conversation began by discussing Totoro’s background before joining Hermit Games two years ago. Like other studio members, he was working in the [b]anime industry[/b] – to be more specific, he was an animation director. [b]Switching to games development was hard at the beginning for him[/b], since telling a story through a game is more complicated than doing it through a non-interactive product.

With the knowledge they gathered thanks to these years of experience in anime, and seeking to pursue their own ambitions, the members of Hermit Games decided to create an adventure in a new world of fantasy and mysteries. They soon discovered that creating good animations for a video game is as hard as beating enemies in a roguelike. Half-jokingly, they decided to honor this idea naming the game Nigate Tale – because [b]“nigate” means being bad at something in Japanese[/b]! 

Also, we chatted about Totoro’s favorite development stage, character creation, and how hard it is to change things without upsetting the balance of the game. Since they must ensure the gameplay is always fun and nerve-wracking, each new update (character, weapon, blessing) requires countless tweaks and adjustments to get the balance right. 

In this regard, Totoro asked the fans to be patient about the new content the game will get in the following months. As of now, the studio is covering several fronts at the same time. [b]They are developing the fourth level of the game, completing the friendship system with more levels and substories, and improving the English and Japanese localization of the game. [/b]

But there’s more to come! Totoro and Steven Zeng from 2P Games confirmed that [b]there will be a console version of the game[/b]. When? “In the near future”. We’ll have to wait to learn more details! Also, Hermit Games is interested in adding a [b]hard mode[/b] and [b]additional bosses[/b] for those players looking for a bigger challenge, and [b]localizing the game into other languages[/b].

It was a remarkably interesting conversation that we can’t wait to repeat with other members of Hermit Games! In the meantime, remember that you can ask anything about Nigate Tale here on Steam forums, on our Discord community server, or sending us a message to our social media official profiles. In one way or another, we’ll be in touch! 

Have a good week!
2P Games

notes.title: Dev Blog #2 - Creating the friendship system
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a busy month, we’re back to tell you more about the development of [i]Nigate Tale[/i]. In our first dev blog, you met our lead artist and discovered the secrets of Hermit Games’ character design process. Today, it is time to talk about a feature you’ve been asking us about many times: [b]the friendship system![/b]

Funny enough, [b]at the beginning of this project, the idea of including monster girls didn’t exist[/b]. In 2019, our team ran a little research on Weibo, a Chinese Twitter-like service, where our fans told us how their ideal monster partner would be in an [i]isekai[/i] adventure like [i]Nigate Tale[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/bcd7dd1d9cd95d996bcce9032a7d7a2f82a65132.png[/img]
[i]#IsekaiWiki Chapter 1 “The Invitation from Monster Partner Club”[/i]

Nearly 80% of the partner designs we received from the lead designer were female monsters, so with his help and what our fans had to say, we finally had our first group of companions! And here comes a fun story: Asa was originally a male partner, but she became a girl after building the 3D model for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/9400c792db50429abbe2af05c6f3256bcab20c38.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/d6454bac32ccdb9f6afec5f073f8440980f2edea.jpg[/img]
[i]Original Design - Alona[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/95a658f503a1c2349b9f28841e20c794264e6ac7.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/5ce57f98ea3a36e5d919c7818f47ef7e4f028f35.jpg[/img]
[i]Original Design - Mayonna[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/79d0a7996242b8a108debdd38063baea6b755423.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/d89a46cb21d47036e377dc304584eb67627f5228.jpg[/img]
[i]Original Design - Dorothy[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/fcb81508991b0406058b0c749c2ea5f50fdcf018.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/e3604d17b4f4c97f59065200ed89bf376efb7fc0.jpg[/img]
[i]Original Design – Asa (In our Original Design, Asa is a male Monster Partner)[/i]

After that revelation, we conceived [i]Nigate Tale[/i] as [b]a mix of roguelite game and light [i]bishōjo[/i] game[/b]. If you’re not familiar with the second concept, [i]bishōjo[/i] games (also known as [i]galge[/i]) are a subgenre of dating sims that revolve around developing a relationship with cute girls.

Depending on your decision, this relationship can be a strong friendship or a romance. These games were a trend in the 90s, but there are still a lot of people around the world who enjoy [i]galge[/i] titles on their PCs and consoles.

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-wVykQ05Ygss/XbJvbdXOqKI/AAAAAAAAAWA/tAWFjZPN1v4ZiTSECuMyEN3nP9nNC4vwwCLcBGAsYHQ/s1600/Visual-novel.jpg[/img]

So back to the idea of the game, that’s where the friendship system came from! But[b] instead of just growing your relationship with them through dialogue decisions, the main character must bring them presents[/b]. Concretely, there is a special cake which was exclusive for the aristocrats that they all love. 

Every time you find a piece, you can go back to the nexus and give it to one of the girls you already met. Then, in exchange, [b]you get something called “blessings” and unlock fragments of their background stories[/b]. These are probably new for you, and that’s because you can only unlock their companion forms in the current version of the game and reach level 3 of the relationship… but there’s more to come this year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814078/09f6730a1115ddc34f757319a6ebcab5944f6337.png[/img]

Remember they will be [b]hosting a Q&A session with us tomorrow on 2P Games’ Discord server[/b], where you will be able to ask us any question related to the game — and its near future. Make sure to join us before [b]4 PM CEST[/b]!

And this is all for today, guys. We hope you found our story both enjoyable and interesting! If you want to get notified when the new dev diaries are out, we strongly recommend you following Nigate Tale here, on Steam, or check 2P Games’ social media profiles from time to time.

[*] Discord: https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU
[/list]

Take care and have a nice day!

Grab your sword and get ready to fight your way out of an ever-changing cursed castle out of space and time: Hermit Games and 2P Games are happy to announce that [b]Nigate Tale, the roguelike dungeon crawler inspired in isekai fantasy stories, is now available on Early Access for $19.99 / €16.99 / £15.99[/b] (with a -15% release discount). In Nigate Tale you play as Roy, a young craftsman who finds himself stuck in a magical castle after a plane crash. This place, out of time and space, shifts and changes constantly, so every incursion into its rooms will be different! You'll have to fight your way through this procedurally generated cursed castle to find a way back home. notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Designing the monster girls
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We hope everything’s well at your side and you’re safe and healthy. We want to let you know that we’re hard at work to bring you Nigate Tale as soon as possible – stay tuned, because we will have something to say about that very soon. But in the meantime, we want to give you [b]a sneak peek at the “backstage” of the game, where the magic is made.[/b] We want you to be (and to feel) a part of our team, to understand where we and the game come from and what we’re doing at any moment (especially during the Early Access stage that will begin soon). That is why we’re starting today [b]a series of Dev Diary Blogs[/b] where we will discuss how we came up with certain features, or how we designed some characters, or introduce you to the team behind Nigate Tale. 

Our first guest in this series is the wonderful artist [url=https://twitter.com/myd1993]摸鱼頔[/url], Moyudi in pinyin (the Chinese language's phonetic transcription to the Latin alphabet). He’s[b] the artist who designed the monster girls you will find in Nigate Tale:[/b] a special kind of character that will be central to your experience in the game. These monster girls are [b]spirit-like creatures,[/b] capable of granting you amazing magical powers – if you get on their good side and manage to befriend them.

摸鱼頔 started his career as a comic book artist until he became a full-time member of Hermit Games, the indie studio behind Nigate Tale. This is his first game, but [b]the processes of designing a character for a comic or a video game are kinda similar[/b] – at least in the beginning. 摸鱼頔 begins with a brief backstory of the character he’s got to draw: it doesn’t need to be super detailed, but at least giving them some depth. Explaining interesting features, what kind of person they are, their idiosyncrasies… In a nutshell, what makes them tick in general. 

This is the process that happened with the monster girls too. Once he got their backstories, he began the creative process by thinking about what kind of wild animal would make sense for each of them, as they all are monster-human hybrids of a sort. E[b]ach “totem” animal had to match in some way the girl’s vibes, [/b]mood and personality. Luckily, 摸鱼頔 loves animals – wild animals, deep-sea animals, and even extinct ancient creatures; he daydreams a lot about how it was when these animals, like dinosaurs, were alive! 

Once he picked the right animal, he also decided on a color palette for each of them. For some, it would be warm colors (red, yellow.. the kind of colors that imply strength, light, positive emotions, but also fury and rage); for others, cold colors made more sense (like blue or green, which usually mean calmness, thoughtfulness, but also sadness and despair). Only then he beings drawing the first sketches. J[b]ust this first stage of the process can take up to 3 or 4 days. [/b]

Let’s see an example: say hello to Chrissy, the Electric Ray Girl, who happens to be 摸鱼頔’s favorite character! She won’t be included in the first Early Access build, mind you – but expect to find her further down the road. Chrissy is a contradictory woman: [b]she’s a lovable girl, funny and witty, but with a lousy temper that she cannot always control.[/b] Based on this description, 摸鱼頔 decided to combine her “human” aspect with two sleek and beautiful, but also dangerous, animals: the electric ray and the stingray. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/2e7048f5d9abf603b84d080e248e32ce810ebc3e.png[/img]
[i]This is an example of a character backstory treatment 摸鱼頔 got[/i]

Once the key aspects of a character’s outfit and design are more or less decided, 摸鱼頔 draws several rough sketches. Then he proceeds to send them to the rest of the team, who decide in a vote which one they’ll keep. [b]Here’s an example of the first 4 drafts for Chrissy: [/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/1dfe88203e5186d425341a3708e7ef389cb847a4.jpg[/img]

After the team has voted their favorite design, 摸鱼頔 begins to work in earnest, fleshing the design out, adjusting all the fine details, and coloring the art until it gets to its final form. You can see below these lines the process: [b]from the thin blue lines of the sketch to the line art inking, then the first flat colors and finally the fine details,[/b] shadows and reflections of the light. Mind the tail, designed after rays’ tails, how the bubbles around the feet reflect Chrissy’s sea nature, and how the patterns in her cloak remind of the scales and patterns you can see in rays’ skins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/088ee455f509328bb76116e04e83bee9b2e81a9c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/cae768dde9adbfd3354d02d46d300625ad2e6744.jpg[/img]

Throughout the whole process, 摸鱼頔 enjoys [b]total creative freedom. [/b]He gets to imagine every monster girl and design them to their tiniest detail, without anyone perking on his shoulder, saying him what he has to do. So far he’s enjoying the process a lot; in his own words, “drawing and designing characters is a relaxing job. To make the character we need, I have to calm down and find the most relaxing way to do it”, he explains. We think this passion for the job shines through all his designs and characters in the game! 

That’s all for today; we hope you like Chrissy’s design process and you enjoyed the read. If there’s something in particular you’d like to learn about the development of Nigate Tale, don’t hesitate to leave us your suggestions in the comments of this post, or in our Discord server or through our social media channels. [b]Stay tuned for news about Nigate Tale, and have a great day![/b]

notes.title: The Story Behind Nigate Tale
notes.content:
We used to be an animation team, served many well-known or unknown game manufacturers, we made promotional films and cut-scenes for them... We had deep affection for ACG that brought us together, and we have done a lot of joy or Excited fragment. After experiencing a lot of glory, wind and rain, an idea suddenly emerged: can we also make our own game? So, a dozen people with a dog started a new journey.

We always feel that games, like animation, are also an expression of storytelling. Since our team members like to watch animation works, in the long chattering battle, the representative of the different worlds won the final victory! Through verification, the monster partner is currently the most popular character theme on the market. About the game-play, after a lot of time groping, based on the advantage of our team and what we are good at, the action games of the Rogue-like category won by an overwhelming advantage. Therefore, we decided to make the first project of our team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/8699a650ffb50f2bd137265bc838397172174e50.png[/img]

This is the origin of "Nigate Tale". (Nigate is the Roman pronunciation of "suffering hand" in Japanese, and "suffering hand" in Japanese means not good at it.) Just like the name of our game, the process of development and game-play are very hard, but it has persisted and barely reaches the level of trial, we hope you can like it.

In 2019, at the domestic independent game exhibition held by Little Black Box, our game met with players for the first time and we collected a lot of valuable opinions to help us to optimize our game.

After repeated debugging, we also gained a good reputation at the Steam Summer Game Festival in 2020.

As a member of our team, the dog named Xiaoxiao, served as the company’s mascot, and at the same time Xiaoxiao actively participated in our work. He also appeared in many operational copy-writing. It is the first one in our team that connects to the outside world, and exists as a linker to another world. Under the influence of its daily cry, our team decided to design an important character for it in "Nigate Tale", and then it will meet you in the game.

Hope you guys enjoy our demo and have a good time ;)

Hi,

Thanks for following Nigate Tale!

Niagte Tale is still in developing. But today, we update the demo for the upcoming Steam Game Festival, We are exciting to hear from you and know what we need to do to make it better! If you have any suggestion, please leave comment below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892856/8699a650ffb50f2bd137265bc838397172174e50.png[/img]

Legend says, there is a lost castle in the sky with living monsters, magic and all the things we can’t imagine. In Nigate Tale, You will be the adventurer who break into that castle by accident. 

If you have the chance to choose escape or living there with cute monster girls, What should you do?
